name: Dazzle
body:
Discipline: psychometabolism; Level Vitalist 0

MANIFESTING

Manifesting Time 1 standard action
Display Visual

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Target One living creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw No; Power Resistance yes
Power Points: psionic focus or 1

DESCRIPTION

You attempt to disrupt the vision of the targeted creature by making a ranged touch attack. If the attack is successful, the creature is dazzled until the beginning of your next turn.
